alt.tl: Sticker na may apat na emergency number at mga larawan.

instruction.de: Ein Haus brennt. Welche Nummer rufen Sie an?
instruction.en: A house is on fire. Which number do you call?
instruction.tl: May nasusunog na bahay. Anong numero ang tatawagan mo?

explanation.de: Notrufe in Österreich: 122 Feuerwehr, 133 Polizei, 144 Rettung, 112 Euro-Notruf.
explanation.en: Emergency numbers in Austria: 122 fire brigade, 133 police, 144 ambulance, 112 European emergency number.
explanation.tl: Mga emergency number sa Austria: 122 bumbero, 133 pulis, 144 ambulansya, 112 European emergency number.

instruction.de: Welche Nummer funktioniert in ganz Europa?
instruction.en: Which number works all over Europe?
instruction.tl: Anong numero ang gumagana sa buong Europe?

explanation.de: Notrufe in Österreich: 122 Feuerwehr, 133 Polizei, 144 Rettung, 112 Euro-Notruf.
explanation.en: Emergency numbers in Austria: 122 fire brigade, 133 police, 144 ambulance, 112 European emergency number.
explanation.tl: Mga emergency number sa Austria: 122 bumbero, 133 pulis, 144 ambulansya, 112 European emergency number.

instruction.de: Hören Sie. Was ist richtig?

explanation.de: Sie hören „hundertvierundvierzig“ = 144: Rettung.
explanation.en: You hear “hundertvierundvierzig” = 144: ambulance.
